text.refs: Reference images: the first shows the clean, crisp ink linework and watercolour clarity to borrow; the second shows the density and the night mood. Do not copy either layout.
text.style: Style: lofi anime night scene with a strong touch of a classic 1990s ink-and-watercolour cutaway book: crisp, clean, precise ink outlines on every object, clear readable shapes, transparent watercolour washes, no murky brown haze. Soft cel shading. People are drawn with slightly chunky storybook proportions (heads a little large, simple friendly faces).
text.color: Colour: varied and lively, NOT one amber tone. Every room has its own colour and its own light: cool white light in the clinic and laundromat, hot pink and violet neon in the karaoke booth and arcade, teal and aqua glow in the bath house, green and purple grow lights in the garden, red paper lanterns at the noodle stall, butter yellow in the bakery, blue screen glow in the gaming rooms, warm amber in only a few homes. Walls painted mint, coral, sky blue, mustard, lilac and cream; colourful furniture, packaging, clothes and plants. People wear many different colourful outfits. The grey hull and deep navy space frame all that colour.
text.crammed: It must feel as crammed as a Japanese night-market alley: many small rooms and stalls squeezed on top of and beside each other, mezzanines, ladders, catwalks, glass elevators and pneumatic tubes between them, and every room overflowing with unique, sensible objects: appliances, furniture, food, snacks, jars, gadgets, tools, plants, posters, cables. Dozens of cheerful people everywhere, every single one busy with their own task: cooking, eating, fixing a robot, watering plants, doing laundry, playing arcade games, singing karaoke, reading, carrying boxes, chatting, napping. Signs are small, short and in English (NOODLES, DUMPLINGS, TEA, ARCADE, KARAOKE, LAUNDRY, REPAIRS, DOG PARK, GARDEN, BAKERY, SNACKS, BATH HOUSE). Cozy, warm, happy and high-tech: nothing scary, no weapons, no danger.
text.denser: Rooms are small and numerous, at least forty little rooms, stalls and nooks inside the sphere, so it reads as a packed vertical city, not a few big boxes. Signs are small.
text.inner: Subject: the whole giant spherical space station as a cutaway, wide framing: the front of the grey armored hull is sliced away to reveal the inside from top to bottom, with the ring around it and docking arms reaching left and right to smaller cut-away modules (a greenhouse dome, a cargo dock with a little shuttle). Two fawn-and-white boxer dogs play with a ball on a patch of artificial grass in the dog park. The station sits slightly low in the frame: the top quarter of the image is calm starry space with nothing in it. A glowing blue planet low in one corner.
text.cover: Subject: a closer, taller view through the middle of the same station: a tall vertical slice of the cutaway, filling the frame edge to edge with stacked decks, as if zoomed in on the station's centre. People are larger here, each about one tenth of the image height, so their faces read clearly. Two fawn-and-white boxer dogs play on a patch of artificial grass in a dog park deck near the middle. The curved grey hull edge is visible at the top, with a strip of starry space above it filling the top quarter of the image, calm with nothing important in it.
